decision: Owner 2026-10-21: remove unnecessary tests, keep necessary ones. A case is removed only when a kept case (or a unit test, for pure logic) proves the same requirement on the same engine.
analysis: Independent read-only analysis of all 62 specs (2026-10-21), checked by the orchestrator against src/domain/boat.test.ts, ug2-hostile-roster crew summary on WebKit and v02 dictation denial.
basisForViewportProject: iphone-13-viewport and pixel-7-chrome are both Chromium with phone user agents (same dedicated-worker storage path, isSafariBrowser false on both); an iPhone-viewport run adds only layout at 390×844, which these specs assert themselves at explicit widths (320/390/412, 200% text).
